note: Private RV park 12 km east of Regina and 1 km north of Hwy 1 (exit 223, then the north service road and Range Road 2180): level, grassy, treed sites set back from the tracks and highway, a heated pool, indoor recreation building and fenced pet park. The operator also stores units year-round. --Claude
